items.title: Adolphe Alexander Interview, 1961-03-08
items.q: I went to Papa Teo and I played and I stayed with him until he took sick.

ctx.x: That's right. Papa Teo. Papa Teo. I went to Papa Teo and I played and I stayed with him until he took sick. Until he took sick.
Well how long was that? That's about how long were you on the clarinet with Papa?
